notes: These are not official journal brand palettes.
Prefer semantic consistency across all figures in one manuscript.
Always test grayscale and color-vision-deficiency readability before submission.

okabe_ito_categorical.best_for: General categorical groups, line plots, bar plots, scatter groups.

nature_muted_evidence.best_for: Nature-style multi-panel figures needing calm, low-saturation evidence colors.
nature_muted_evidence.source_inspiration: Muted journal figure styling plus colorblind-safe contrast.

science_high_contrast.best_for: Dense comparison plots where groups must separate clearly.
science_high_contrast.source_inspiration: High-contrast research figure styling with colorblind-aware blue/orange/teal anchors.

cs_ml_algorithm_comparison.best_for: Computer science and machine learning papers: method comparisons, ablations, benchmarks, and line plots.
cs_ml_algorithm_comparison.source_inspiration: IEEE/ACM-style accessible plots: color plus marker/line style, strong contrast, and grayscale readability.

ieee_grayscale_markers.best_for: IEEE-style two-column papers where figures must remain readable in grayscale print.
ieee_grayscale_markers.source_inspiration: IEEE guidance to use color plus shape, thick lines, unique markers, brightness contrast, and grayscale checks.

acm_interface_study.best_for: ACM/HCI/user-study papers: conditions, interface variants, task outcomes, and accessible figure descriptions.
acm_interface_study.source_inspiration: ACM accessibility guidance: figures should not rely on color alone and should be describable in text.

mechanical_stress_strain.best_for: Mechanical engineering plots: stress-strain curves, load-displacement curves, fatigue comparisons, and material tests.
mechanical_stress_strain.source_inspiration: ASME-style print-aware engineering figures: black/gray baselines with clear blue/orange/green accents.

robotics_control.best_for: Robotics, control, trajectory tracking, state estimation, and hardware experiment figures.
robotics_control.source_inspiration: Engineering control plots requiring clear actual/reference/error separation.

manufacturing_quality.best_for: Manufacturing, process monitoring, tolerance, quality control, and defect classification figures.
manufacturing_quality.source_inspiration: Industrial engineering style with neutral process colors and explicit warning/failure colors.

thermal_cfd_sequential.best_for: Mechanical/thermal/CFD scalar fields: temperature, pressure, velocity magnitude, and stress intensity.
thermal_cfd_sequential.source_inspiration: Perceptual engineering colormap alternative to rainbow/jet.

materials_phase_map.best_for: Materials, design space, phase maps, optimization landscapes, and signed performance deltas.
materials_phase_map.source_inspiration: Engineering design maps where low/high and negative/positive regions must be separable.

cell_mechanism.best_for: Biology, pathway, mechanism, cell-state, and schematic figures.
cell_mechanism.source_inspiration: Cell-style mechanism figures with warm highlight and cool structural colors.

clinical_neutral_accent.best_for: Clinical cohorts, demographic comparisons, survival plots, and restrained medical figures.
clinical_neutral_accent.source_inspiration: Medical journal style: neutral base with one or two strong accents.

earth_continuous.best_for: Continuous environmental, spatial, intensity, or model-output data.

cividis_accessible_continuous.best_for: Continuous data that must remain readable for color-vision-deficient readers.

blue_orange_diverging.best_for: Effect direction, residuals, enrichment/depletion, and signed change.
blue_orange_diverging.source_inspiration: Blue-orange diverging maps used as red-green alternatives.

grayscale_with_accent.best_for: Print-safe figures, methods diagrams, and figures where one finding needs emphasis.
grayscale_with_accent.source_inspiration: Print-first journal figures with one color accent.
